QUOTE: "3. high = ret & 0xFF80 // module/category bits ... 4. low = ret & ~0xFF80 // specific reason bits ... if buf already has text: append \" : \"" and "A code that combines a high-level and a low-level part produces a concatenated string such as \"X : Y\"."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer describes the high-level (module) and low-level (reason) parts of a code, and says strerror renders both joined with " : " when both are present.
